create_camera_path: create a CameraPath instance with a ViserServer and duration element to manage camera keyframes and spline interpolation
add_camera_keyframe: add a Keyframe to the CameraPath using add_camera to set a new camera position and orientation in the render trajectory
interpolate_pose_and_fov: interpolate camera pose and FOV at a normalized time using CameraPath.interpolate_pose_and_fov_rad for smooth camera animation
apply_float_colormap: apply a colormap like viridis or turbo to a single channel tensor image using apply_float_colormap to produce an RGB tensor
populate_general_render_tab: populate a Viser GUI render tab with controls for keyframes, FOV, resolution, spline tension, and video export using populate_general_render_tab
